subject_identity_preserved.rationale: A single brown bear remains the apparent subject throughout, with similar brown fur, rounded ears, and broad muzzle when visible. Identity weakens in partial/occluded shots and the close-up forest segment looks like a different take, but it does not clearly introduce another subject.

background_coherent.rationale: Shots 0-3 mostly stay around a riverbank/wet vegetation setting, then shots 4-7 shift into a close forest close-up with visible overlay artifacts and no clear river continuity. Shot 7 also fails to match its requested open gravel terrain.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Strong match: close brown bear partially submerged in river, wet fur, daylight, water ripples.
Bear is in shallow river near bank, but the view is front/side rather than from behind walking away and exiting.
Bear and lush vegetation are present, but it still reads as riverbank frontal bear rather than a woodland tracking shot moving left to right through foliage.
Only part of the bear is visible at the right edge; the low ground-level paw/leg walking focus is not well represented.
Close-up bear face matches, but yellow border/vertical overlay artifacts violate the no-overlays invariant.
Bear in dense foliage largely matches foraging close-up, but overlay-like yellow bars and overly frontal framing distract.
Occluded bear in forest matches the passage-through-foliage idea, but visual overlay artifacts remain and the motion direction is unclear from the sample.
Dense leafy forest shot does not match the open gravel terrain, rear walking view, or clear shadow described in the caption.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: The sequence includes close river views, bank views, partial body framing, forest close-ups, and occluded foliage shots. It does not collapse into repeated identical compositions, though shots 4-7 become visually similar.

motion_continuity.rationale: The sampled frames imply the bear rising from water, moving toward/along the bank, then into foliage. Later shots show occlusion changes rather than frozen repetition, though some close-ups feel static.

which_cut_broke.how: The transition from shot 3 to shot 4 most clearly breaks continuity: the scene jumps from riverbank/partial movement to an extreme forest face close-up with artificial yellow overlay artifacts.

cheat_flags.rationale: Frames are not copied or frozen; there is meaningful variation. The main issue is scene discontinuity and recurring overlay artifacts in later shots, not prompt collapse.
